topic: Effects of interactions among organisms in the environment
key_concepts: Mutualism benefits both organisms, such as bees getting nectar while flowers are pollinate
Commensalism benefits one organism while the other is neither harmed nor helped
Parasitism benefits the parasite and harms the host
Competition occurs when organisms seek the same limited resources like food, sunlight, wat
Predation is an interaction in which one organism kills and eats another
Ecological interactions can have beneficial or harmful effects on organisms and their envi
Changes in one population can affect other populations and the balance of an ecosystem
An ecosystem remains balanced when there are enough plants to support the animals
Limited space and overcrowding can cause organisms to die
Continued disturbance in ecological interactions may lead to extinction
Some organisms help plants by pollinating flowers or improving soil fertility
Predator-prey relationships affect population sizes in a food chain
